item.title: Marionette Zero
item.description:

  • 日本語名: Marionette Zero
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Several thousand years ago, a secret plan called “Heaven’s Stone” was carried out. A “Heaven’s Stone” was an artificial stone created by extracting a special power out of a certain stone. As a result, an unexpectable phenomenon happened and some reinforced their bodies and some felt no pain. Therefore, only a few people were allowed to carry the stone. However, a dreadful plan was being proceeded underwater….

item.title: Maria ~Tenshi no Kiss to Akuma no Hanayome~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tail Wind
  • 発売日: 2008-01-25
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Maria～天使のキスと悪魔の花嫁～
  • 英語名: Maria Tenshi no Kiss to Akuma no Hanayome

あらすじ

Maria comes to the planet in search of Alp, her friend. Maria meets Ren, a devil buster, there and they pursue Alp together. But they accidentally kiss! Ren apologizes her, but she says, “Don’t apologize…, my darling.” It seems her first kiss means “engagement”. He is surprised to know that, but they get married…. Alp also gets shocked to hear that. Actually, Alp loves Maria. That’s why he teases her to get her attention. Alp gets mad and sends 4 angels, who used to be Maria’s partners. They all wear black armors…, yes, they become succubuses! To save them, Maria needs to become a succubus as well and have sex with them. She hesitates at first, but she decides to become a succubus for Ren and the angels…! What will happen to them in the end…?

あらすじ

The main character is Haruto, a soldier. One day, he loses his life during a battle. To get back to life, he’ll need to get the energy of other people. However, it’s hard to do so…. Just when he gives up, Noah and Firia stop him. They decide to offer their bodies to him….
